d: Long, flowing midnight-blue hair is styled with a high side ponytail and long bangs framing the face, paired with wide, expressive teal eyes. The face appears youthful with a slender, petite build. The outfit consists of a white sleeveless sailor-style top with a brown collar and bow, paired with voluminous, pleated crimson hakama pants. Signature details include white hair ornaments and grey mechanical ship rigging attached to the back and arms, featuring various gun turrets and a large grey cannon.
